note: Seed flavour profiles for the Cubanitos card so the new intensity bars have something to draw. Both are read off each blend's own catalogue summary rather than invented: the Natural's copy names chestnut, baking spice, coffee bean, cedar and gentle sweetness over a Cameroon wrapper, so nuts leads at 4 with spice and cedar at 3 and sweetness low at 2. The Maduro's copy names dark cocoa, molasses, espresso and a cedar-and-black-pepper finish with a heavier, sweeter body, so sweet leads at 4 with pepper, earth, cedar and smoke raised against the Natural. These are an editorial starting point for the bars, not tasting data; neither blend has been smoked. The blendVariants list restates both blends because a patch replaces that array wholesale, and only flavourProfile is set on each, so every other field on both blends is preserved.
